packageRules.description: windows-core has to stay on the version the windows crate depends on: two versions break the COM traits used by the audio code (the build fails). Bump both by hand when a windows release moves to a new windows-core.

All minor and patch updates (Rust crates and GitHub Actions) in one weekly PR. Not automerged because it contains crates that ship in the app; fix(deps) so release-please cuts a patch release. Major updates keep their own PR.
